full_judgment: Considering the factual aspect of the case to the effect that the matter was sent for further investigation after reopen the case to the CID thereafter till now for more than a year the CID could not complete the investigation, even after expiry of the period of limitation, we are inclined to enlarge them on bail on exercising our discretion under section 167(5) of the Code of Criminal Procedure. We find merits in this rule.
